health: I give explicit consent to the processing of my answers about skin conditions, allergies, pregnancy and the categories of medicines I take, of the routines I create and their daily ticks, of my product preferences, the products I check and my shopping list, of my answers to the fitness questions (pregnancy, injuries, goals) and the workouts I do, and of my daily plate entries, solely to build and keep a personal and safe care, workout and nutrition plan. This data is stored encrypted, is not shared with third parties and is not used for analytics. I can withdraw consent at any time in Settings → Privacy; the data is then deleted from the server within 24 hours.
analytics: I agree to the collection of usage statistics (screens opened, features used) under an identifier that does not directly reveal who I am, to understand how the app is used. My health answers are never sent to analytics.
marketing: I agree to receive emails with Parla news and tips. I can unsubscribe via the link in any email.
